2120489023693025708.author: TheMoonHailey
2120489023693025708.context: TheMoonHailey: dice que tras cada gran hackeo de exchange Bitcoin terminó superando su máximo histórico, que Binance vuelve a estar en los titulares y apuesta a que $BTC llega a $100.000 en 30-60 días.
2120489023693025708.suggested_text: Whether $BTC hits six figures in 30-60 days or not, every exchange hack teaches the same thing: coins on an exchange aren't yours until you withdraw them. The upside only matters if you still hold the keys when it comes.

2120489966669303849.author: moneyordebt
2120489966669303849.context: moneyordebt: compara CAGR desde fines de junio 2024: NVDA bajó a 14% (venía de 75% la década previa) y Bitcoin subió a 8,5% anual; dice que la «Jensen inequality of the power law» apoya a Bitcoin a largo plazo.
2120489966669303849.suggested_text: Slowing CAGR is exactly what a power law predicts: returns decay over time instead of compounding at a fixed rate, so judging it on a 2-year window says little. The useful check is where price sits versus the trend and its bands. I laid out that projection to 2050 here: https://x.com/forecastquant/status/2119169301949141264

2120491883017511421.author: SatoshiDropsHQ
2120491883017511421.context: SatoshiDropsHQ: afirma que los net shorts de Bitcoin están en máximo histórico y que las últimas cuatro veces que los shorts estuvieron tan concentrados, $BTC marcó un piso.
2120491883017511421.suggested_text: Crowded shorts are fuel, not a timer. Four past cases is a small sample, and a squeeze can also come after one more leg down. What data source are you using for net shorts? I'd like to see how long each of those four took to bottom.
